svg.desc: 1298 commits across five public projects, 68 active days, peak 126 commits per day. 2026-09-04 through 2026-11-26 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-26T04:34:58.618Z.
